purpose: Reusable Central Agent contract for every managed Chrome extension connection. Page-open, login state, or --load-extension alone is never VERIFIED.

strategies.background_service_worker: Require expected chrome-extension service_worker target plus service-specific roundtrip when available.
strategies.content_script_plus_popup: Require popup-to-content or equivalent content-script message roundtrip, service-specific marker, or observable extension response on the target tab. Do not require a service worker when manifest has none.
strategies.content_script_only: Require a content-script-specific message/marker/observable response on the exact target tab.
strategies.extension_page: Require expected extension page target and service-specific command/readback evidence.

targetContext.landingPagePolicy: A product landing page is CONTEXT_OPENED only, never CONTEXT_VERIFIED when the real input surface lives in a project/notebook/workspace.
targetContext.navigationPolicy: Use service-specific exact URL when known; otherwise use guarded trusted navigation to the workspace and verify the resulting URL/UI state before input testing.
targetContext.routeDiscovery: Return visible project/create/workspace route hints when exact input surface is absent.

cdpPolicy.allowedExistingScope: Dedicated ChromeForTesting + dedicated user-data + local loopback CDP through an already allowlisted central runner/governor route.
allowedProbeActions: read target list and page state
trusted navigation clicks that do not generate paid output
prohibitedWithoutNewGate: normal Chrome restart or settings change
new Chrome extension permission/security prompt approval

serviceRouteTemplate.targetContextRule: Prefer exact existing project/notebook/workspace over product landing page

evidence: actual executed script SHA when runner exposes it
runnerSourceIntegrity.rule: If the same pre-fix line/error appears after a verified source fix, stop blind retry and verify runner source freshness before rerunning the failed gate.

failureLearning.retryRule: Only retry after a changed condition and begin at failedGate

completionRule: VERIFIED only after architecture-correct extension activity + exact target context + input verification + command/result/ACK evidence and x2 same-fixture regression; connectivity-only probes must not spend credits.
